source_institution: Ministry of Finance, Government of India — Union Budget
source_family: Union Budget Expenditure Profile / Demands for Grants
transformations: retain Budget Estimate capital and total expenditure by ministry/department
derive year-on-year growth only within the same reviewed official ministry series
apply only deterministic reviewed ministry mappings with effective date ranges
known_limitations: Historical ministry/department structures and demand numbers change over time and require reviewed effective-dated mappings.
No budget observations are committed in this manifest itself.
The experiment must report INSUFFICIENT VERIFIED EXTERNAL DATA when reviewed historical tables/mappings are absent or too sparse.
No fuzzy ministry matching is allowed.
